content.en_us:
How to get it :
- [[gv:machine_precass|Precision Assembly Machine]] : 32 x [[gv:circuit_chip|Microchip]], 32 x [[gv:circuit_capacitor|Capacitor]], 16 x [[gv:circuit_capacitor_tantalium|Tantalum Capacitor]], [[gv:circuit_controller_chassis|Control Unit Casing]], [[gv:upgrade_speed_1|Speed Upgrade Mk.I]], 16 x wire (Lead), 1000 mB Perfluoromethyl.
- [[Soldering Station|Soldering Station]] : 1000 mB Perfluoromethyl, 32 x [[gv:circuit_chip|Microchip]], 32 x [[gv:circuit_capacitor|Capacitor]], 16 x [[gv:circuit_capacitor_tantalium|Tantalum Capacitor]], [[gv:circuit_controller_chassis|Control Unit Casing]], 4 x Rubber Bar, 16 x wire (Lead).

Used to make :
[[gv:mp_warhead_10_nuclear_large|Size 10 Nuclear Warhead]], [[gv:mp_warhead_10_nuclear|Size 10 Micro Nuclear Warhead]], [[gv:mp_warhead_15_nuclear|Size 15 Nuclear Warhead]], [[gv:satellite_radar|Radar Satellite]], [[gv:satellite_relay|RoR Relay Satellite]], [[gv:sat_dock|Cargo Landing Pad]], [[Satellite Ground Station|Satellite Ground Station]], [[gv:satellite_scanner|Depth Scanning Satellite]], [[gv:missile_soyuz_0|Soyuz-FG]], [[gv:satellite_science|Space Laboratory]] and 2 more.
